jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer / VP of Technology
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer / VP of Technology based in United States.

As the executive technology leader for a global energy advisory firm of roughly 300 professionals across Europe and North America, you will hold complete accountability for the entire technical ecosystem. This pivotal role balances high-level commercial impact with a practical, hands-on approach, bridging internal corporate systems with sophisticated client-facing digital products. You will lead cross-border enterprise IT, oversee a distributed international team, direct managed services, and orchestrate modern AI and automation strategies to scale operations efficiently. Operating in an agile, business-first environment without heavy administrative friction, your technical vision and execution will directly shape company growth, vendor partnerships, and core client capabilities across multiple regions.

Accountabilities

Enterprise IT and operations across multiple countries, including network infrastructure, cybersecurity, endpoint management, global service desk, and identity and access management.
Internal business systems and reporting architecture, maintaining and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Finance & Operations, and associated data workflows.
Portfolio management of client-facing platforms in two regions, defining product roadmaps, ensuring system connectivity, and driving continuous platform maintenance.
AI and automation integration, collaborating directly with business units to optimize processes and deploy modern tools that drive growth without proportional headcount expansion.
Strategic technology cost management, managing global vendor relationships, licensing negotiations, and outsourced managed-service arrangements.
Leadership and mentorship of a distributed, multi-country technology team, fostering a high-performance culture across time zones.

Requirements

Proven track record leading technology strategy and execution within a mid-sized organization, encompassing both internal business systems and client-facing digital products.
Deep experience in the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 environments.
Hands-on operational leadership style, actively engaging with and building upon modern tools rather than solely delegating or overseeing high-level governance.
Strong commercial acumen with demonstrable success in vendor negotiations, licensing optimization, and multi-country technology budget management.
High adaptability and cross-cultural communication skills required to lead distributed teams and support operations across various time zones.
Pragmatic, business-first mindset suited for a lean, efficient environment that values speed and outcomes over heavy process or top-down IT governance.
Familiarity with modern data platform architecture (Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI), experience navigating corporate ownership transitions, or prior energy sector exposure is highly advantageous.

Benefits

Competitive executive salary package reflecting the impact and scale of the role.
Fully remote work model offering geographic and schedule flexibility.
Comprehensive healthcare and medical coverage plan.
Global business exposure and opportunities for professional leadership growth in a scaling, international energy advisory environment.
Direct access to executive decision-makers and key business stakeholders in a streamlined, low-bureaucracy organizational culture.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: VP, IT Business Solutions
jobs.description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY - This position is based in Arlington, VA

The VP, IT Business Solutions will partner with the CITO and business leaders to lead the organization’s technology strategy, drive innovation, and transform business operations through the effective implementation of IT solutions, including the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI capabilities. The role will also ensure delivery of information technology solutions that maximize the benefits of technology, generate organizational impact, and confirm that the results are measured and communicated—leveraging data, analytics, automation, and AI to improve outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning

Lead business solutions strategic planning and execution that support business objectives and drive growth.
Drive digital transformation and change management initiatives by identifying opportunities for process improvement and innovation. Ensure opportunities are included in the roadmap and governance.
Creating a culture of multiyear strategic planning elevating IT into a strategic partner.
Oversee the selection, deployment, and management of enterprise-wide software applications, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
Plan effective governance.
Define and drive an enterprise AI strategy and roadmap (including generative AI), identifying high-value use cases, aligning priorities with business objectives, and ensuring responsible AI governance.
Partner with data, security, privacy, risk, and legal stakeholders to establish AI standards (data quality, model lifecycle, vendor evaluation, and controls) and drive adoption through training, change management, and measurement of business value.
Bring outside-in perspectives into the organization by routinely meeting with industry peers and other external sources.

Operational Management

Lead a team of IT professionals responsible for solution architecture, development, implementation, and support.
Build and lead AI-enabled delivery capabilities (e.g., intelligent automation, analytics, and GenAI solutions), ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and integrated into business processes and platforms.
Build both horizontal and vertical relationships that deliver impact.
Ensure that business needs get formalized, tracked, and resolved.
Craft effective communication strategies for both IT and the business.
Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for IT products and services.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards relating to IT systems and solutions.
Provide leadership and mentorship to the IT team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
Creates and manages budget for business solutions and the project teams.

Project Management/Agile Leadership

Partner with leadership on pre-project ideation.
Plan effective business demand shaping, governance alignment, prioritization, and successful execution.
Partner with business and other IT leaders to build business cases, plan new initiatives, and determine how they fit into the roadmap and priorities. Propose new projects to IT governance.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Position may require some travel.
This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

Formal Education & Certification

Master’s degree in computer systems design or computer science, and/or years of equivalent work experience.

Knowledge & Experience

15 or more years work experience in information technology.
8 or more years in a senior leadership role within IT, with a focus on business solutions and technology strategy.
5 or more years of experience managing teams of professional employees.
Strong understanding of solution architecture, IT software development lifecycle, agile, and emerging technologies.
Demonstrated experience leading AI and/or generative AI initiatives from concept to production, including use-case identification, vendor/partner evaluation, risk management, and change adoption.
Working knowledge of responsible AI practices, including privacy, security, bias mitigation, model monitoring, and data governance.
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong business acumen and strategic thinking capabilities.

Preferred

Alignment to CI’s values: passion, integrity, teamwork, respect, courage, and optimism.
Self-motivated and capable of managing multiple priorities and tasks as delegated.
Team-player with the ability to work within a collaborative environment.
Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to work with diverse personality types.
Ability to coach the team to reach their highest potential.
Creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
Collaborative in driving decisions.
Ability to deal with multiple projects and deadlines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
Sense of urgency.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

Conservation International is committed to pay equity, transparency, and supporting employees across locations. Salary Range:

jobs.title: Director, Information Technology
jobs.description:
Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes.
We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. By combining deep clinical trial expertise with cutting-edge AI, we connect sponsors' scientific ambitions with high-performing research teams that expedite and expand access to novel therapeutics for patients in need. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide.

The Director, IT will lead Iterative Health’s technology infrastructure, systems, security, and IT operations as the company continues to scale across its corporate and clinical research network. This role will be responsible for building a secure, reliable, and scalable technology environment that enables employees to do their best work while supporting the operational needs of a growing healthcare technology and services organization.
The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on IT leader who can balance long-term technology planning with day-to-day execution. You will partner closely with leaders across teams to ensure technology solutions are aligned with business priorities, scalable, secure, and user-friendly.
Where You’ll Drive Impact IT Strategy & Leadership Develop and execute a scalable IT strategy aligned with Iterative Health’s business and growth objectives.
Establish IT roadmaps, priorities, standards, and operating processes across the organization.
Serve as a strategic technology advisor to executive and functional leaders.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and employee experience.
Develop and manage the IT budget, vendors, contracts, and technology investments.
Build and mature the IT function from an initial lean team into a scalable organization capable of supporting a rapidly growing, multi-site healthcare technology and services business.
Lead, coach, and develop the Corporate IT team.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, service expectations, and performance metrics.

Infrastructure & IT Operations Oversee corporate IT infrastructure, networks, endpoints, applications, identity management, and collaboration tools.
Ensure reliable, streamlined, secure, and scalable technology across corporate offices, remote employees, and clinical research sites while keeping costs efficient.
Establish standards for device provisioning, lifecycle management, access management, and technical support.
Build effective IT service management processes, including help desk, incident management, asset management, and service-level expectations.
Establish the IT operating model, organizational structure, processes, policies, and service standards required to support the company’s evolving technology needs.

Cybersecurity, Privacy & Compliance Oversee the company’s cybersecurity program, and work with the internal team to set security strategy, policies, controls, risk management, monitoring, incident response, and employee security awareness.
Oversee vulnerability management, endpoint protection, identity and access controls, and security awareness programs (IT and networking infrastructure initially, but may extend to cloud systems eventually). 
Coordinate incident response and business continuity planning for technology-related risks and lead information and security for the company. 

Systems & Applications Partner with business leaders to assess, select, implement, and optimize enterprise applications and technology platforms.
Establish governance around application ownership, integrations, data flows, and technology standards.
Identify opportunities to consolidate systems, automate workflows, and improve data connectivity.
Support technology integrations related to acquisitions, partnerships, and organizational growth.
Establish governance for enterprise applications, including application ownership, administrative access, lifecycle management, integrations, licensing, renewals, security requirements, and data ownership.
Establish standards for SSO, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, role-based access, and application access reviews.
Identify and implement opportunities to automate employee lifecycle, access management, IT operations, and cross-functional administrative workflows.

Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with People and Finance on systems supporting employees, payroll, financial operations, and business administration.
Partner with Clinical Operations and site leadership to support technology needs across the clinical research network.
Establish a formal co-governance structure with Product & Engineering to ensure appropriate technology, security, and compliance controls are in place, with clear ownership, accountability, and separation of duties.
Provide clear communication to employees and leadership regarding technology changes, risks, and priorities.
Performs related duties as requested
Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement to establish technology and security requirements for third-party vendors and participate in vendor risk assessments. 

Technology Integration & Expansion Lead IT due diligence and technology integration for acquisitions, partnerships, new offices, and clinical research sites.
Develop repeatable standards for onboarding acquired organizations, users, devices, applications, networks, and data.
Identify technology risks, integration costs, system redundancies, and remediation requirements during due diligence.
Develop transition plans for identity, endpoints, collaboration platforms, networking, SaaS applications, and security controls.

What You Bring 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant experience leading enterprise IT operations.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
Experience leading IT within a high-growth, healthcare, technology, life sciences, or similarly complex organization.
Proven experience developing and executing an enterprise IT strategy and roadmap.
Strong understanding of infrastructure, SaaS applications, networking, endpoint management, identity and access management, and cybersecurity.
Experience managing IT budgets, vendors, technology implementations, and third-party service providers.
Experience building and leading high-performing IT teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
Strong understanding of IT governance, security, privacy, compliance, and risk management.
Experience supporting distributed or multi-site organizations preferred.
Experience with M&A technology integration or organizational scaling strongly preferred.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
A pragmatic, service-oriented leadership style with the ability to operate strategically while remaining close to execution.

How We Work 

Collaborative and low-ego team environment
High ownership and accountability culture
Fast-paced and highly iterative growth environment
Open communication and continuous learning mindset
Mission-driven organization focused on improving patient outcomes
Comfortable navigating evolving business priorities and opportunities

Benefits That Support You We believe great teams do their best work when they feel supported — professionally and personally. Hybrid work environment with in-office collaboration two days per week in either our NYC, Boston and Southlake office
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with up to 80% of premiums covered by Iterative Health
Mental health and wellness support through Spring Health
Health HSA or FSA options, and commuter FSA contributions supported by Iterative Health
Unlimited PTO, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide shutdown between Christmas and New Years
401(k) program with a company match of up to 3% (up to $3,000 annually)
Weekly in-office lunch benefit every Tuesday
100% company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
Annual wellness and professional development stipend to support your health and growth
And more!

New York pay range: $150,000 USD - $200,000 USD

We are focused on building an equitable and inclusive culture, and by extension, hiring process. jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Manager in the R&I Independence Technology Team (ITT), you will play a pivotal role in maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice and solutions. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will focus on identifying and mitigating potential risks that could impact an organization's operations and objectives. You will be responsible for developing business strategies to effectively manage and navigate risks in a rapidly changing business environment.

As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional network to deliver quality results. You will motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. With increased autonomy, you will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate. Your ability to develop and sustain high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our firm.

In this role, you will craft and convey clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story. You will apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities, validate outcomes with stakeholders, and share alternative perspectives. Your leadership will guide the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging, and uncertain situations.

Responsibilities

Leading enterprise risk management initiatives to identify and mitigate potential risks impacting organizational operations and objectives
Developing business strategies to effectively manage risks in a rapidly changing environment
Applying analytical thinking to assess business risk and implement mitigation measures
Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story to stakeholders
Directing teams through complex situations, demonstrating composure and strategic questioning
Validating outcomes with stakeholders and acting on feedback to improve risk management processes
Modeling and reinforcing professional and technical standards, including the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements
Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to develop high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams
Utilizing business process improvement techniques to enhance internal controls and regulatory compliance
Building relationships with business leaders to identify and address risk challenges effectively

What You Must Have

At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
At least 6 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Finance, Risk Management/Insurance
Demonstrating advanced skills in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
Utilizing Business Process Improvement techniques to drive results
Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities
Excelling in contract negotiation and contractual risk mitigation
Leading teams through complexity with composure and strategic questioning
Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Dangerous Goods, North America Dangerous Goods and Storage Compliance Operations
jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to become Earth's most customer-centric company and to grow in a safe environment for both our customers and our associates. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic, and passionate people.

The Dangerous Goods (DG) team is looking for a motivated Senior Program Manager with strong regulatory experience, operational knowledge, logistics experience, and a hands-on passion to dive deep into processes that support Amazon's growth in a safe environment for customers, partners, and associates.

Working across procurement, transportation services, delivery experience, returns and re-commerce, technology, storage, legal, public policy, and other relevant internal teams on a global scale, this Senior Program Manager will ensure the safety of our associates and transportation partners by delivering innovative solutions for the safe and compliant transportation of DG, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

This Senior Program Manager will plan and execute DG policies, controls, and processes to ensure the safe and compliant transportation of DG across a global supply chain. Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, consultants, and regulators, this role will drive safety and compliance across customer deliveries and reverse logistics, enable new selection, and expand business and transportation models. This Senior Program Manager will develop accurate, relevant, metric-driven analysis to foster continuous improvement and step-function innovation that enhances our internal and external customer experience.

Candidates must be based in one of the corporate locations listed in the requisition.

Candidates must be able to travel at least 25% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

Drive continuous improvement projects across global teams, ensuring Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) leads the industry in transportation safety and compliance.
Manage a portfolio of projects aimed at building a best-in-class Dangerous Goods transportation system.
Convert large and complex projects into manageable pieces to deliver iterative improvements while focusing on longer-term, large-scale deliverables.
Build collaborative relationships with leaders across regions, departments, and business units.
Refine existing program processes to more efficiently track and prioritize issues, enabling the team to scale its work.
Anticipate project bottlenecks, manage escalations, make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus operational or technical constraints.

A day in the life

This role works to transform how Amazon safely transports dangerous goods across its global supply chain. You'll leverage continuous improvement and metric-driven analysis to advance transportation safety, classification systems, and compliant transshipment processes across Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) and its transportation partners. You'll define program strategy with business owners, build relationships across regions and business units, and communicate regularly with senior leadership on project risks, escalations, and tradeoffs as a subject matter expert in dangerous goods transportation.

About The Team

The Dangerous Goods team ensures the safety of our Customers, associates and carrier partners by delivering innovative solutions to ensure dangerous goods compliance, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
Master's degree or equivalent
IMDG, 49CFR, ICAO/IATA, or region specific accreditation

You will lead cross-border enterprise IT, oversee a distributed international team, direct managed services, and orchestrate modern AI and automation strategies to scale operations efficiently. new_jobs.title: VP, IT Business Solutions
new_jobs.description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY - This position is based in Arlington, VA

The VP, IT Business Solutions will partner with the CITO and business leaders to lead the organization’s technology strategy, drive innovation, and transform business operations through the effective implementation of IT solutions, including the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI capabilities. The role will also ensure delivery of information technology solutions that maximize the benefits of technology, generate organizational impact, and confirm that the results are measured and communicated—leveraging data, analytics, automation, and AI to improve outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning

Lead business solutions strategic planning and execution that support business objectives and drive growth.
Drive digital transformation and change management initiatives by identifying opportunities for process improvement and innovation. Ensure opportunities are included in the roadmap and governance.
Creating a culture of multiyear strategic planning elevating IT into a strategic partner.
Oversee the selection, deployment, and management of enterprise-wide software applications, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
Plan effective governance.
Define and drive an enterprise AI strategy and roadmap (including generative AI), identifying high-value use cases, aligning priorities with business objectives, and ensuring responsible AI governance.
Partner with data, security, privacy, risk, and legal stakeholders to establish AI standards (data quality, model lifecycle, vendor evaluation, and controls) and drive adoption through training, change management, and measurement of business value.
Bring outside-in perspectives into the organization by routinely meeting with industry peers and other external sources.

Operational Management

Lead a team of IT professionals responsible for solution architecture, development, implementation, and support.
Build and lead AI-enabled delivery capabilities (e.g., intelligent automation, analytics, and GenAI solutions), ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and integrated into business processes and platforms.
Build both horizontal and vertical relationships that deliver impact.
Ensure that business needs get formalized, tracked, and resolved.
Craft effective communication strategies for both IT and the business.
Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for IT products and services.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards relating to IT systems and solutions.
Provide leadership and mentorship to the IT team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
Creates and manages budget for business solutions and the project teams.

Project Management/Agile Leadership

Partner with leadership on pre-project ideation.
Plan effective business demand shaping, governance alignment, prioritization, and successful execution.
Partner with business and other IT leaders to build business cases, plan new initiatives, and determine how they fit into the roadmap and priorities. Propose new projects to IT governance.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Position may require some travel.
This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

Formal Education & Certification

Master’s degree in computer systems design or computer science, and/or years of equivalent work experience.

Knowledge & Experience

15 or more years work experience in information technology.
8 or more years in a senior leadership role within IT, with a focus on business solutions and technology strategy.
5 or more years of experience managing teams of professional employees.
Strong understanding of solution architecture, IT software development lifecycle, agile, and emerging technologies.
Demonstrated experience leading AI and/or generative AI initiatives from concept to production, including use-case identification, vendor/partner evaluation, risk management, and change adoption.
Working knowledge of responsible AI practices, including privacy, security, bias mitigation, model monitoring, and data governance.
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong business acumen and strategic thinking capabilities.

Preferred

Alignment to CI’s values: passion, integrity, teamwork, respect, courage, and optimism.
Self-motivated and capable of managing multiple priorities and tasks as delegated.
Team-player with the ability to work within a collaborative environment.
Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to work with diverse personality types.
Ability to coach the team to reach their highest potential.
Creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
Collaborative in driving decisions.
Ability to deal with multiple projects and deadlines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
Sense of urgency.

new_jobs.title: Director, Information Technology
new_jobs.description:
Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes.
We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. By combining deep clinical trial expertise with cutting-edge AI, we connect sponsors' scientific ambitions with high-performing research teams that expedite and expand access to novel therapeutics for patients in need. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide.

The Director, IT will lead Iterative Health’s technology infrastructure, systems, security, and IT operations as the company continues to scale across its corporate and clinical research network. This role will be responsible for building a secure, reliable, and scalable technology environment that enables employees to do their best work while supporting the operational needs of a growing healthcare technology and services organization.
The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on IT leader who can balance long-term technology planning with day-to-day execution. You will partner closely with leaders across teams to ensure technology solutions are aligned with business priorities, scalable, secure, and user-friendly.
Where You’ll Drive Impact IT Strategy & Leadership Develop and execute a scalable IT strategy aligned with Iterative Health’s business and growth objectives.
Establish IT roadmaps, priorities, standards, and operating processes across the organization.
Serve as a strategic technology advisor to executive and functional leaders.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and employee experience.
Develop and manage the IT budget, vendors, contracts, and technology investments.
Build and mature the IT function from an initial lean team into a scalable organization capable of supporting a rapidly growing, multi-site healthcare technology and services business.
Lead, coach, and develop the Corporate IT team.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, service expectations, and performance metrics.

Infrastructure & IT Operations Oversee corporate IT infrastructure, networks, endpoints, applications, identity management, and collaboration tools.
Ensure reliable, streamlined, secure, and scalable technology across corporate offices, remote employees, and clinical research sites while keeping costs efficient.
Establish standards for device provisioning, lifecycle management, access management, and technical support.
Build effective IT service management processes, including help desk, incident management, asset management, and service-level expectations.
Establish the IT operating model, organizational structure, processes, policies, and service standards required to support the company’s evolving technology needs.

Cybersecurity, Privacy & Compliance Oversee the company’s cybersecurity program, and work with the internal team to set security strategy, policies, controls, risk management, monitoring, incident response, and employee security awareness.
Oversee vulnerability management, endpoint protection, identity and access controls, and security awareness programs (IT and networking infrastructure initially, but may extend to cloud systems eventually). 
Coordinate incident response and business continuity planning for technology-related risks and lead information and security for the company. 

Systems & Applications Partner with business leaders to assess, select, implement, and optimize enterprise applications and technology platforms.
Establish governance around application ownership, integrations, data flows, and technology standards.
Identify opportunities to consolidate systems, automate workflows, and improve data connectivity.
Support technology integrations related to acquisitions, partnerships, and organizational growth.
Establish governance for enterprise applications, including application ownership, administrative access, lifecycle management, integrations, licensing, renewals, security requirements, and data ownership.
Establish standards for SSO, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, role-based access, and application access reviews.
Identify and implement opportunities to automate employee lifecycle, access management, IT operations, and cross-functional administrative workflows.

Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with People and Finance on systems supporting employees, payroll, financial operations, and business administration.
Partner with Clinical Operations and site leadership to support technology needs across the clinical research network.
Establish a formal co-governance structure with Product & Engineering to ensure appropriate technology, security, and compliance controls are in place, with clear ownership, accountability, and separation of duties.
Provide clear communication to employees and leadership regarding technology changes, risks, and priorities.
Performs related duties as requested
Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement to establish technology and security requirements for third-party vendors and participate in vendor risk assessments. 

Technology Integration & Expansion Lead IT due diligence and technology integration for acquisitions, partnerships, new offices, and clinical research sites.
Develop repeatable standards for onboarding acquired organizations, users, devices, applications, networks, and data.
Identify technology risks, integration costs, system redundancies, and remediation requirements during due diligence.
Develop transition plans for identity, endpoints, collaboration platforms, networking, SaaS applications, and security controls.

What You Bring 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant experience leading enterprise IT operations.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
Experience leading IT within a high-growth, healthcare, technology, life sciences, or similarly complex organization.
Proven experience developing and executing an enterprise IT strategy and roadmap.
Strong understanding of infrastructure, SaaS applications, networking, endpoint management, identity and access management, and cybersecurity.
Experience managing IT budgets, vendors, technology implementations, and third-party service providers.
Experience building and leading high-performing IT teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
Strong understanding of IT governance, security, privacy, compliance, and risk management.
Experience supporting distributed or multi-site organizations preferred.
Experience with M&A technology integration or organizational scaling strongly preferred.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
A pragmatic, service-oriented leadership style with the ability to operate strategically while remaining close to execution.

How We Work 

Collaborative and low-ego team environment
High ownership and accountability culture
Fast-paced and highly iterative growth environment
Open communication and continuous learning mindset
Mission-driven organization focused on improving patient outcomes
Comfortable navigating evolving business priorities and opportunities

Benefits That Support You We believe great teams do their best work when they feel supported — professionally and personally. Hybrid work environment with in-office collaboration two days per week in either our NYC, Boston and Southlake office
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with up to 80% of premiums covered by Iterative Health
Mental health and wellness support through Spring Health
Health HSA or FSA options, and commuter FSA contributions supported by Iterative Health
Unlimited PTO, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide shutdown between Christmas and New Years
401(k) program with a company match of up to 3% (up to $3,000 annually)
Weekly in-office lunch benefit every Tuesday
100% company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
Annual wellness and professional development stipend to support your health and growth
And more!

new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to become Earth's most customer-centric company and to grow in a safe environment for both our customers and our associates. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic, and passionate people.

The Dangerous Goods (DG) team is looking for a motivated Senior Program Manager with strong regulatory experience, operational knowledge, logistics experience, and a hands-on passion to dive deep into processes that support Amazon's growth in a safe environment for customers, partners, and associates.

Working across procurement, transportation services, delivery experience, returns and re-commerce, technology, storage, legal, public policy, and other relevant internal teams on a global scale, this Senior Program Manager will ensure the safety of our associates and transportation partners by delivering innovative solutions for the safe and compliant transportation of DG, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

This Senior Program Manager will plan and execute DG policies, controls, and processes to ensure the safe and compliant transportation of DG across a global supply chain. Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, consultants, and regulators, this role will drive safety and compliance across customer deliveries and reverse logistics, enable new selection, and expand business and transportation models. This Senior Program Manager will develop accurate, relevant, metric-driven analysis to foster continuous improvement and step-function innovation that enhances our internal and external customer experience.

Candidates must be based in one of the corporate locations listed in the requisition.

Candidates must be able to travel at least 25% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

Drive continuous improvement projects across global teams, ensuring Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) leads the industry in transportation safety and compliance.
Manage a portfolio of projects aimed at building a best-in-class Dangerous Goods transportation system.
Convert large and complex projects into manageable pieces to deliver iterative improvements while focusing on longer-term, large-scale deliverables.
Build collaborative relationships with leaders across regions, departments, and business units.
Refine existing program processes to more efficiently track and prioritize issues, enabling the team to scale its work.
Anticipate project bottlenecks, manage escalations, make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus operational or technical constraints.

A day in the life

This role works to transform how Amazon safely transports dangerous goods across its global supply chain. You'll leverage continuous improvement and metric-driven analysis to advance transportation safety, classification systems, and compliant transshipment processes across Amazon Network Fulfillment (AFN) and its transportation partners. You'll define program strategy with business owners, build relationships across regions and business units, and communicate regularly with senior leadership on project risks, escalations, and tradeoffs as a subject matter expert in dangerous goods transportation.

About The Team

The Dangerous Goods team ensures the safety of our Customers, associates and carrier partners by delivering innovative solutions to ensure dangerous goods compliance, redefining industry best practices and standards, and safely enabling an ever-changing borderless business model.

5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
